task.originalTaskRequest: Execute Phase 2.2D Controlled Optimization Selection Gate only. Evaluate exactly the six frozen candidates, select at most one smallest evidence-backed Phase 2.3 primary mechanism, produce exactly 64 numbered report sections and exactly 92 acceptance conditions, preserve all accepted authority, run only non-stress validation, complete migration readiness and canonical PMOS/MEMOROS continuity, and do not implement or start Phase 2.3.

analysis.executionSummary: Phase 2.2D is complete and PASS. Exactly six frozen candidates and all 15 unordered candidate interactions were evaluated against the accepted Phase 2.2C diagnosis. C01 CACHE_MISS_COALESCING was selected as the sole Phase 2.3 primary mechanism with STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_DIRECT confidence because it is the smallest independently testable change that directly removes concurrent duplicate same-key application full-table read ownership while preserving the existing query and business-safe filtering semantics. C02 and C03 remain conditional secondary mechanisms, C04 and C05 are deferred, and C06 is rejected as a production optimization while retained as validation hygiene. The final gate passes 92/92 conditions with exactly 64 report sections. Thirteen non-stress regression checks passed, no stress execution occurred, no runtime behavior source changed, and Phase 2.3 is ready only for a separate authorization decision.
analysis.reasoningSummary: The accepted P09 cause is concurrent uncoalesced full-table application reads. C01 directly reduces same-key read-owner count without changing row selection, mapping, description fallback, ordering, result TTL, or response semantics. C02 can reduce cost per owner read but does not remove concurrent owner count and has a larger semantic and index surface because current search includes JSON-carried descriptions. C03 limits work after abort but does not prevent initial fan-out and depends on unproven Prisma and PostgreSQL cancellation behavior. C04 and C05 require post-C01 evidence, while C06 improves experimental isolation rather than production capacity. Selection therefore follows causal directness and minimum sufficient scope rather than an arbitrary score.
